messages.content: Write a polished short scene in modern American English between two consenting adults who are attracted to each other while doing an ordinary task together. Keep the romantic tension subtle and believable. Let attraction show through proximity, hesitation, attention, and ordinary conversation rather than declarations. Keep the scene grounded, contemporary, and non-explicit.

“Move over.”

Casey stood beside the open kitchen drawer, trying to fit a stack of towels inside.

Morgan looked down at the pile.

“You folded them wrong.”

Casey glanced at her. “There's a wrong way to fold a towel?”

“Yes.”

“Show me.”

Morgan stepped closer.

“Like this.”

She took one towel from the pile and folded it in half, then once more.

Casey watched her hands.

“That's it?”

“That's it.”

“It doesn't look different.”

“It is.”

“You're very confident.”

“I know towels.”

Casey smiled. “Apparently.”

Morgan reached past her for another one.

Their shoulders brushed.

Neither moved right away.

Casey looked over.

Morgan was already looking at her.

“You okay?” Casey asked.

“Yeah.”

A beat passed.

“You're staring again,” Casey said.

Morgan smiled. “Maybe.”

Casey picked up another towel. “Maybe you're distracting me.”

“That sounds like a you problem.”

“It is.”

Morgan took the towel from her.

“You're folding this wrong too.”

“I think you're making rules because you want to keep me here.”

Morgan looked at her.

“Maybe.”

Casey laughed softly.

The drawer was still open between them.

Morgan closed it with one hand.

“Done.”

Casey looked at the drawer, then back at her.

“That was fast.”

“Could've been faster.”

“Sure.”

Morgan smiled.

Neither of them moved toward the doorway.
